data.name: Send Senses
data.description: As a standard action, you place a scrying sensor at a point within %1 feet that you can see and have line of effect to. You can see or hear (not both) through this sensor %2 rounds. The sensor otherwise functions as a clairaudience/clairvoyance spell with a caster level equal to your arcanist level. You can use this ability %3 times per day.|100+ArcanistSavantSchoolLVL*10|max(ArcanistSavantSchoolLVL/2,1)|INT+3
